hints: Think about the two different acids found in acid rain and which pollutant gas leads to each one.
Recall that $\text{NO}_2$ dissolves in rain with oxygen and water to give nitric acid, so statement 1 is true.
Compare the real recipe for photochemical smog with the catalytic role of $\text{NO}_2$ in oxidising $\text{SO}_2$, then decide which of statements 2 and 3 fits.
walkthrough:
**Check statement 1 - nitric acid and acid rain**

Think of $\text{NO}$ first oxidised to $\text{NO}_2$, then $\text{NO}_2$ reacting further. This is a well known route to acid rain.

Chemical idea:
$$2\text{NO} + \text{O}_2 \rightarrow 2\text{NO}_2$$
$$4\text{NO}_2 + 2\text{H}_2\text{O} + \text{O}_2 \rightarrow 4\text{HNO}_3$$

**Check statement 2 - photochemical smog**

Photochemical smog needs sunlight, nitrogen oxides, volatile organic compounds (unburnt hydrocarbons) and ozone. It produces ozone, PANs and aldehydes.

Carbon monoxide is a toxic pollutant from incomplete combustion, but it is not the partner that reacts with $\text{NO}$ and $\text{NO}_2$ to make photochemical smog. So statement 2 is false.

**Check statement 3 - catalysing oxidation of sulfur dioxide**

In the atmosphere $\text{SO}_2$ is oxidised to $\text{SO}_3$, which then forms sulfuric acid, $\text{H}_2\text{SO}_4$. Nitrogen dioxide acts as a catalyst for this oxidation.

Chemical idea:
$$\text{SO}_2 + \text{NO}_2 \rightarrow \text{SO}_3 + \text{NO}$$
The $\text{NO}$ is re-oxidised, so $\text{NO}_2$ is regenerated. So statement 3 is true.

**Combine the true statements**

Statement 1 is true, statement 2 is false, statement 3 is true. That gives 1 and 3 only.

options.A: Incorrect because it includes statement 2. Photochemical smog involves $\text{NO}_x$ with VOCs and sunlight to give ozone and PANs, not a reaction with carbon monoxide.
options.B: Incorrect because it includes statement 2 and leaves out statement 3. Statement 2 is false, while statement 3 is true since $\text{NO}_2$ does catalyse $\text{SO}_2$ to $\text{SO}_3$ in the atmosphere.
options.C: Correct because statements 1 and 3 are both true. $\text{NO}_x$ forms $\text{HNO}_3$ in acid rain, and $\text{NO}_2$ catalyses the oxidation of $\text{SO}_2$ to form $\text{H}_2\text{SO}_4$, while statement 2 is false.
options.D: Incorrect because it includes the false statement 2 and leaves out the true statement 1. Statement 1 is definitely correct as $\text{NO}_2$, $\text{O}_2$ and $\text{H}_2\text{O}$ give nitric acid.
